days.subtheme: Permission to not have it figured out
days.title: You're Not Behind, You're Becoming
days.featured_quote: You are allowed to be a work in progress and still be worthy of love right now.
script_lines: You don't need to have this all figured out yet.
Growth is allowed to look messy and slow.
You're not behind, you're exactly where you are.
Be as patient with yourself as you'd be with someone you love.
Confusion is not the same thing as failure.
You are allowed to still be learning this.
Gentleness is not weakness, it's wisdom.

days.subtheme: Treating yourself like a friend you love
days.title: Would You Say That To A Friend?
days.featured_quote: Talk to yourself like someone you are trying to help, not someone you are trying to fix.
script_lines: Imagine speaking to yourself the way you speak to your best friend.
Would you call her lazy for needing rest?
Would you call her stupid for making one mistake?
You deserve the same kindness you give so freely to others.
Self-compassion isn't selfish, it's basic emotional maintenance.
Start today by softening just one sentence in your head.
You are someone worth being gentle with.

days.title: Your Inner Critic Has Been Lying To You
days.featured_quote: The voice that criticizes you the loudest is the one you should trust the least.
script_lines: That voice telling you you're not enough is lying.
Your inner critic was never trying to help you grow.
It was trying to keep you small and 'safe.'
You get to choose a different voice now.
One that says, you're doing better than you think.
Healing starts the moment you stop believing every thought.
You are not your harshest thought about yourself.

days.title: Rest Isn't Something You Have To Earn
days.featured_quote: Rest is not the reward for your worth, it's part of it.
script_lines: Rest is not something you have to earn.
You don't need to collapse before you're allowed to stop.
Productivity was never the measure of your worth.
Your body has been asking for softness for a while now.
Today, let rest be enough, nothing to prove.
You are allowed to do nothing and still matter.
Tired is not a character flaw.

days.title: One Mistake Isn't Your Whole Story
days.featured_quote: You are not the worst thing you've ever done, you are everything you've done since.
script_lines: One mistake is not your whole story.
You are allowed to mess up and still be good.
Shame says you are the mistake, truth says you made one.
Growth looks like trying again after you fall short.
You've survived every hard moment that felt unsurvivable.
That's proof of your strength, not luck.
You are still worthy, even on your messiest days.

days.title: The Small Win Nobody Clapped For
days.featured_quote: Not every victory needs an audience to count.
script_lines: You got out of bed today, that counts.
You don't need a big win to deserve pride.
Small steps are still steps forward.
Notice what you did right today, not just what you missed.
Progress usually whispers quietly before it ever shouts.
You are closer than you were yesterday.
Let yourself feel proud of the quiet wins too.

days.title: Welcome Back To Yourself
days.featured_quote: You don't have to earn your way back to yourself, you just have to stop leaving.
script_lines: You don't have to go anywhere to find yourself.
You've been here the whole time, waiting to be noticed.
Coming home means softening toward who you already are.
You are not behind on becoming yourself.
This version of you is enough for this chapter.
You can stop performing and just exist for a moment.
Welcome back to yourself, you were worth the wait.
